The Windows-path leak check gap is caused by `json.dumps` escaping backslashes before the search runs. I did not change `src/`.

**Cause (verified):** `leaks()` in `src/leaks.py:8` serializes the transcript with `json.dumps` and then lowercases it. JSON writes each backslash as two characters, so `C:\Users\dana` in a command becomes `c:\\users\\dana` in the searched text. The secret `C:\Users\dana` is never found in that text. The `/home/dana` form has no backslashes, so it survives serialization and matches. The repr I printed confirms this: `'...
